verdict.rationale: Gemini API documents explicit safety settings with four adjustable filter categories for gating/restricting content (gemini-docs-10, gemini-docs-16, gemini-docs-28), plus function calling patterns that let developers control when/how model output triggers real-world actions (gemini-docs-3), and a published Prohibited Use Policy governing usage (gemini-supp-terms). Missing for 10: a dedicated standalone moderation endpoint (separate from generation) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration validating real-world effectiveness of the safety filters.
